gloss: to be conceited; to get above oneself

definitions.gloss: to be conceited; to get above oneself; to grow arrogant
definitions.explanation: To think too much of oneself and behave as if one were above others or above one's station. Always critical.

examples.japanese: ⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧くらい⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{思|おも}い{上|あ}がって⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧いけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't get conceited just because you've had a little success.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若|わか}く→若い：00823_wakai⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧になった⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{思|おも}い{上|あ}がって、⟦{周|まわ}り→周り：01732_mawari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}かなく→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: Having become company president so young, he grew arrogant and stopped listening to the people around him.

notes:
An intransitive godan verb. The noun is {思|おも}い{上|あ}がり (conceit), as in {思|おも}い{上|あ}がり⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{甚|はなは}だしい→甚だしい：13520_hanahadashii⟧ (the height of arrogance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がるな: don't get above yourself
- {思|おも}い{上|あ}がった⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: an arrogant attitude
- ⟦{成功|せいこう}して→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧{思|おも}い{上|あ}がる: to let success go to one's head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{自惚|うぬぼ}れる→自惚れる：32087_unuboreru⟧: to be conceited — about one's looks or abilities; often used in self-mockery
- ⟦{調子|ちょうし}→調子：03491_choushi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{乗|の}る→乗る：00511_noru⟧: to get carried away — lighter and more colloquial
- ⟦{傲慢|ごうまん}→傲慢：07635_gouman⟧: arrogant — the adjective for the resulting attitude
